retired_by.reason: FrankenNetworkX 0.4.1 ships personalized_pagerank, so graph::ppr computes PPR through it and the context rerank, Pack DNA PPR neighbors and suggest-links signal run again in production.

trigger.description: Pack PPR influence is requested while the pinned FrankenNetworkX release lacks deterministic personalized PageRank. Turning the feature on gives ee pack a PPR weight of graph.ppr.alpha (0.30 by default), and the rerank runs once the pack has a candidate.
setup_commands: ee remember --workspace . --level semantic --kind fact 'Graph-aware retrieval ranks memories by text and by their links.' --json

expected_emission.repair_string: Ranking already falls back to text. To stop requesting PPR, run `ee config set graph.feature.ppr.enabled false` and drop --ppr-weight from `ee context`; Pack DNA reports this whenever it runs, until a pinned FrankenNetworkX personalized PageRank API is available.
